records.subject: Household Income
records.groupTitle: Monthly Household Market Income Per Household Member Among Resident Households at Selected Percentiles
records.title: Monthly Household Market Income (Including Regular Government Contributions) Per Household Member Among Resident Households at Selected Percentiles, 2015 - 2025
records.footnote: Note: It is notable that some resident households in the lowest income decile owned a car (7.2%), employed a domestic worker (21.4%), lived in private property (8.9%) or were resident households comprising solely non-employed persons aged 65 years and over (43.0%) in 2025. Not all households are consistently in the same decile group from one year to the next. For example, a household may move from a higher to a lower decile in a particular year due to reduced income if a household member is temporarily unemployed, before moving up the deciles when the member resumes employment in the subsequent year. In comparing the performance of any particular decile group over time, it is therefore relevant to note that the comparison may not pertain to the same group of households. Data for the latest year are preliminary.

column1.footnote: 1/ Based on ranking of all resident households by their monthly household market income (including regular government contributions) per household member.
